abstract: This paper examines the implications of the EU–UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement (TCA) using a dynamic spatial general equilibrium model. Unlike previous studies that primarily projected potential impacts of Brexit based on uncertain scenarios, this analysis introduces new estimates of tariffs and non‐tariff measures specified by the TCA. The findings show that while the TCA will necessitate substantial adjustments for some sectors, Brexit will not fundamentally alter the overall structure of the UK economy. However, the main impacts will manifest as significant hits to real wages and productivity, exacerbating the long‐standing economic challenges faced by the UK.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文运用动态空间一般均衡模型，评估了欧盟-英国贸易与合作协定（TCA）的经济影响。与以往主要基于不确定情景预测英国脱欧潜在影响的研究不同，本文引入了TCA所规定的关税与非关税措施的最新估算。研究结果表明，尽管TCA将迫使部分行业进行重大调整，但英国脱欧并不会从根本上改变英国经济的整体结构。然而，其主要影响将体现为实际工资与生产率的显著下降，从而加剧英国长期面临的经济挑战。
title: Counting the costs: a quantitative assessment of the effects of Brexit on UK regions and sectors
title_zh: 量化成本：英国脱欧对英国各地区和行业影响的定量评估

abstract: The pension sector is an important investor group in global financial markets and a key holder of government and corporate debt. This article examines the evolution of pension fund asset allocations around the globe and documents two important structural changes. First, pension investors have shifted portfolio share allocations away from fixed income securities. This trend is robust across Defined Contribution (DC) and Defined Benefit (DB) programs as well as country groups. Second, pensions have instead shifted allocations into riskier investments within mutual funds as well as alternative investments. We hypothesize that a global decline in interest rates is one potential driver of this change. Using a global sample, we show that declining local currency government bond yields are associated with lower bond pension portfolio shares and higher holdings shares of mutual funds and foreign assets. We discuss the potential implications of these trends for borrowing costs. The declining holding share of pensions as a long-term investor group implies financing costs are less sensitive to new debt issues, but more sensitive to global uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 养老金部门是全球金融市场中的重要投资者群体，也是政府和公司债务的主要持有者。本文研究了全球范围内养老基金资产配置的演变，并记录了两个重要的结构性变化。首先，养老金投资者已将投资组合份额从固定收益证券中转移出来。这一趋势在固定缴款（DC）和固定收益（DB）计划以及不同国家组中均表现稳健。其次，养老金转而将资金配置到共同基金中风险更高的投资以及另类投资中。我们假设全球利率下降是这一变化的潜在驱动因素之一。利用全球样本，我们表明本币政府债券收益率的下降与养老金投资组合中债券份额的降低以及共同基金和外国资产持有份额的增加相关。我们讨论了这些趋势对借贷成本的潜在影响。作为长期投资者群体，养老金持有份额的下降意味着融资成本对新债务发行的敏感度降低，但对全球不确定性的敏感度增加。
title: Global Pension Asset Allocations and Debt Markets
title_zh: 全球养老金资产配置与债务市场

abstract: Studies provide conflicting evidence on what accounting restatements reveal about industry peers. Gleason et al. (2008) suggest that restatements reflect contemporaneous earnings management, while Kedia et al. (2015) argue that restatements induce peers to begin misstating earnings. We re-examine peers’ reporting responses to restatements and find that the results of Kedia et al. (2015) are sensitive to design choices that affect the measurement of key variables. When this measurement error is minimized, we find no evidence that peers begin misstating following restatements. Using nonrestatement-based measures, we find that peers exhibit less aggressive reporting, especially when prior accrual use is high and when peers share the same auditor office. Overall, industry peers do not appear to increase earnings management following restatements. Instead, restatements primarily reflect contemporaneous misreporting and, in some cases, lead to less aggressive reporting by peers.
title: Do restatements generate contagion? A re-examination

abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between functional specialization (FS) in global value chains (GVCs) and wages. Drawing on the GVC theory and intellectual monopoly capitalism theory, both highlighting asymmetries in international production and knowledge networks, it is postulated that FS in fabrication and FS in research and development (R&D) have differentiated effects on the evolution of wages. To test this hypothesis, we embed measures of FS in a structural wage regression and estimate the relationship for 25 EU countries over the period 2003–2022. We find some evidence for this hypothesis, notably a negative association between FS in fabrication and wages. Furthermore, we obtain partial confirmation of the expected patterns in our instrumental variable regressions, although the findings are not fully robust across all specifications.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了全球价值链（GVC）中的功能专业化（FS）与工资之间的关系。基于全球价值链理论与智力垄断资本主义理论（两者均强调国际生产与知识网络中的不对称性），本文提出假设：制造功能专业化与研发（R&D）功能专业化对工资演变具有差异化影响。为验证该假设，我们将功能专业化指标嵌入结构性工资回归模型，并对2003-2022年间25个欧盟国家进行估计。研究结果部分支持该假设，尤其发现制造功能专业化与工资呈负相关关系。此外，工具变量回归虽部分验证了预期模式，但该结论在所有模型设定中并非完全稳健。
title: Functional specialization and wages in Europe
title_zh: 欧洲的功能专业化与工资

abstract: We estimate the trade and income effects of regulatory developments concerning standard‐like non‐tariff measures (NTMs) over 2012–2017 combining structural gravity estimates and general equilibrium projections. The trade cost effects of regulatory changes vary at the country‐pair level and across sectors. Overall, NTM‐related regulatory changes over 2012–2017 increased trade costs in goods, which reduced global trade by 1.2%. The majority of this reduction corresponds to a decline in goods trade equivalent to about 40% of the actual worldwide decrease of nominal goods trade over this period. Yet the implied reduction of real income is small. We highlight significant variation of these effects at the country and sector level, and show that excluding pair‐specific trade frictions and third‐country effects introduces omitted variable bias. Our findings imply that advances in international coordination of technical regulation can further reduce trade frictions and enhance trade and real income.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文结合结构引力估计与一般均衡预测，评估了2012–2017年间标准类非关税措施监管变化对贸易和收入的影响。监管变化的贸易成本效应在国家-行业层面存在异质性。总体而言，2012–2017年间与非关税措施相关的监管变化提高了商品贸易成本，导致全球贸易下降1.2%。这一降幅中，大部分对应商品贸易的减少量，约占同期全球名义商品贸易实际下降幅度的40%。然而，由此导致的实际收入下降幅度较小。我们强调这些效应在国家与行业层面存在显著差异，并表明忽略国家-行业特定贸易摩擦及第三国效应会引入遗漏变量偏误。研究结果表明，技术监管国际协调的进展可进一步减少贸易摩擦，促进贸易与实际收入增长。
title: General equilibrium effects of technical non‐tariff measures: evidence from bilateral trade cost estimates
title_zh: 技术性非关税措施的一般均衡效应：基于双边贸易成本估计的证据

abstract: This paper examines the relationship between participation in the EU Rural Development Program and the economic performance of Italian olive farms using a finite‐mixture model with inverse‐probability‐weighted regression adjustment. Based on 2010–2022 FADN panel data, it estimates heterogeneous treatment effects while correcting for selection bias. Results suggest that RDP participation is associated with higher net income, by about EUR 280/ha on average. Two farm clusters emerge, also reflecting different typologies of rural development program measure packages: family‐run farms in disadvantaged areas are often associated with agro‐climatic environmental commitments and related packages and gain about €265/ha. By contrast, more profitable and labor‐intensive farms are more frequently linked to less adopted measures and benefit only marginally. A Monte Carlo simulation assesses the estimator's performance under a controlled data‐generating process. The study highlights the need to account for structural heterogeneity in policy evaluation and supports data‐driven rural development strategies.
abstract_zh: 本文采用有限混合模型与逆概率加权回归调整方法，探究欧盟农村发展计划参与对意大利橄榄农场经济绩效的影响。基于2010-2022年FADN面板数据，在纠正选择偏差的同时估计异质性处理效应。结果表明，参与农村发展计划与净收入提升相关，平均每公顷约增加280欧元。研究识别出两类农场集群，分别对应不同的农村发展计划措施组合类型：位于欠发达地区的家庭经营农场通常与农业气候环境承诺及相关措施包相关联，每公顷增收约265欧元；而利润更高、劳动密集型的农场则更多与采用率较低的措施相关，仅获得边际收益。通过蒙特卡洛模拟在受控数据生成过程中评估了估计量的表现。本研究强调政策评估中需考虑结构性异质性，并为数据驱动的农村发展战略提供支撑。
title:
Differentiated Impacts of
                    EU
                    Rural Development Measures: A Finite Mixture Evaluation of Italian Olive Farms
title_zh: 欧盟农村发展措施的差异化影响：意大利橄榄农场的有限混合评估

abstract: Land rights, important dimensions of land tenure, are crucial for smallholder farmers’ land tenure security and climate change adaptation. However, there are knowledge gaps on the nexus between land rights and climate adaptation in Ghana, particularly from a gendered perspective. This study draws on land right frameworks to explore the nexus between gender, land rights and climate change adaptation among men and women smallholder farmers in rural Ghana. Data were collected through a randomized survey administered to 510 smallholder farmers from four purposively selected communities in the Adansi Asokwa District, and analyzed using descriptive and inferential statistics. The results showed that compared to women, more men own more farmlands (averagely 6.8 vs. 5.4 acres for women), have formal land title deeds, and exercise more land rights, particularly exclusion and alienation rights, enhancing their tenure security. Besides frequency of pest invasion, there is no significant differences in men’s and women’s climate change perceptions and experiences. Farmers used multiple climate adaptation strategies, including planting improved crop varieties, changing planting season, climate information services and agrochemical application. We found a significant difference between men’s and women’s adoption of crop diversification, crop-livestock integration and seed storage. Unlike men’s adaptation strategies, those of women are influenced by the number of rights they exercise and farmland size. Also, perceptions about the raining season and temperature intensity as well as marital status, locality, years of farming experience, access to non-farm livelihood activities and credit significantly influence farmers’ climate change adaptation. Gender differentiated policies and incentives for farmers are needed to enhance tenure security and climate change adaptation.
abstract_zh: 土地权利作为土地制度的重要维度，对小农户的土地权属保障和气候变化适应能力至关重要。然而，关于加纳土地权利与气候适应之间关系的研究仍存在知识空白，尤其是从性别视角切入的分析。本研究基于土地权利理论框架，探讨加纳农村地区男女小农户在性别、土地权利与气候变化适应之间的关联机制。通过对阿丹西阿索夸地区四个定向选取社区的510名小农户进行随机问卷调查，并运用描述性统计与推断性统计分析数据。结果表明：相较于女性，男性拥有更多农田（平均6.8英亩 vs 女性5.4英亩）、持有正式土地所有权证书，并享有更多土地权利（特别是排他权和转让权），从而增强了其土地权属保障。除虫害侵袭频率外，男女农户在气候变化认知与经历方面无显著差异。农户采用多种气候适应策略，包括种植改良作物品种、调整种植季节、利用气候信息服务及施用农用化学品。研究发现，男女农户在作物多样化、种养结合及种子储存方面的采纳行为存在显著差异。与男性适应策略不同，女性农户的适应行为受其行使权利数量及农田面积的影响。此外，对雨季和气温强度的认知、婚姻状况、居住地、务农年限、非农生计活动参与及信贷获取等因素显著影响农户的气候变化适应能力。需制定性别差异化的农户政策与激励措施，以增强土地权属保障和气候变化适应能力。
title: Gender, land rights and climate change adaptation in Ghana: Implications for land tenure, agriculture and rural development
title_zh: 加纳的性别、土地权利与气候变化适应：对土地权属、农业和农村发展的影响

abstract: Can markets discipline socially costly misbehavior abroad? We explore the market penalty associated with major human rights violations—specifically, the assassination of mining activists, a context where formal legal recourse is rare and events often do not involve counterparties. We show that firms featured in media coverage of these incidents experience significant, negative abnormal stock returns. Whereas reactions to related forms of corporate misconduct may be transitory or muted, we find that the market responses are both substantial and persistent, with a median 10-day loss exceeding USD 100 million. Since formal legal sanction is exceedingly rare, we consider the role of market penalties. We highlight three mechanisms that are consistent with reputational costs: (1) Media attention magnifies the market response. (2) Information-sensitive institutional investors systematically divest following assassination events. (3) Events reduce future trade, leading to a 19% decline in new contracts with counterparties. Despite these costs, events persist. We find that assassinations increase with dependence on mining royalties, suggesting that local rents sustain conflict despite market pressure. Thus, reputational sanctions may be significant—even in weakly institutionalized settings—yet may not fully deter misbehavior when local and global incentives diverge.
abstract_zh: 市场能否对海外高成本不当行为形成约束？本文聚焦重大人权侵犯事件——具体而言，即采矿活动人士遇刺事件（此类情境下正式法律救济极为罕见，且事件通常不涉及交易对手方），探究市场惩罚机制。研究表明，媒体报道中涉及此类事件的企业会遭受显著且负面的异常股票收益。相较于企业不当行为相关反应可能具有短暂性或弱化特征，我们发现市场反应既显著又持久，其中位10日损失超过1亿美元。鉴于正式法律制裁极为罕见，我们重点考察市场惩罚的作用机制。我们提出与声誉成本相一致的三种传导路径：（1）媒体关注放大了市场反应；（2）信息敏感型机构投资者在刺杀事件后系统性减持；（3）事件导致未来贸易减少，新合同签订量下降19%。尽管存在这些成本，事件仍持续发生。研究发现，刺杀事件与矿业特许权使用费依赖度呈正相关，表明即便面临市场压力，地方租金仍会维持冲突。因此，声誉制裁在制度薄弱环境中可能具有显著效力，但当地方与全球激励存在分歧时，未必能完全遏制不当行为。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: The Value of Names: Civil Society, Information, and Governing Multinationals,
title_zh: 名称的价值：公民社会、信息与跨国公司的治理

abstract: Restrictive immigration policies can force organisations to alter their workforce composition, with unclear effects on organisational performance. We study the effects of the 2016 Brexit referendum, which reduced the share of EU-nationality nurses in English hospitals. Using administrative patient-level data and a continuous difference-in-differences design, exploiting hospitals’ pre-referendum exposure, we estimate the causal impact of a negative labour supply shock on care quality. Hospitals with higher pre-referendum EU nurse shares experienced higher post-referendum emergency patient mortality, equivalent to 1,238 additional deaths annually in the three years after the referendum. Consistent with theoretical predictions, hospitals responded to labour shortages by relaxing hiring standards: foreign nurses recruited after the referendum were appointed to lower salary grades, suggesting lower skills and experience.
abstract_zh: 限制性移民政策可能迫使组织改变其劳动力构成，但对组织绩效的影响尚不明确。我们以2016年英国脱欧公投为研究对象，该事件导致英格兰医院中欧盟籍护士比例下降。利用行政层面的患者数据以及连续双重差分设计，通过医院在公投前的暴露程度，我们估算了负向劳动力供给冲击对护理质量的因果影响。公投前欧盟护士比例较高的医院，在公投后急诊患者死亡率更高，相当于公投后三年内每年额外增加1,238例死亡。与理论预测一致，医院通过放宽招聘标准来应对劳动力短缺：公投后招聘的外籍护士被分配到较低薪资等级，表明其技能和经验水平较低。
title: Immigration, Workforce Composition, and Organisational Performance: The Effect of Brexit on NHS Hospital Quality
title_zh: 移民、劳动力构成与组织绩效：英国脱欧对NHS医院质量的影响

abstract: Social norms that are costly for individuals are held in place because of social pressure to conform. Historical examples include duelling in Europe and footbinding in China; contemporary examples include female genital cutting and wasteful consumption. Such norms exhibit varied dynamics. Some collapse after staying unchanged for centuries, while others erode gradually. Still others escalate gradually before collapsing. This paper develops a theoretical framework that explains these patterns in terms of different forces of social influence and lends itself to empirical estimation. The analysis can guide the design of policies aimed at mitigating or eliminating costly norms, and shows that some interventions can be counterproductive.
abstract_zh: 摘要 对个体而言代价高昂的社会规范之所以得以维系，源于社会遵从压力。历史案例包括欧洲的决斗传统与中国缠足习俗；当代案例则涵盖女性割礼与炫耀性消费。此类规范呈现出多元演变特征：有的在延续数百年后骤然瓦解，有的逐步消解，还有的则在崩溃前经历渐进升级过程。本文构建的理论框架通过阐释社会影响力的不同作用机制来解释上述模式，并适用于实证估计。该分析可为旨在缓解或消除代价高昂规范的政策设计提供指导，同时揭示某些干预措施可能适得其反。

abstract: This paper investigates whether healthcare access affects educational achievement, exploiting the staggered ACA Medicaid expansion. Using county-level panel data on ACT scores, insurance coverage, and health indicators for 2012–2024, I find that Medicaid expansion raised county-level ACT composite scores by 0.50 to 0.85 points (about 0.22 standard deviations in the controlled specification). A Callaway and Sant’anna heterogeneity-robust estimator yields a simple aggregated ATT of 0.79, indicating the result is not an artefact of forbidden comparisons, and an event study is consistent with parallel pre-trends, with effects building to approximately 1.3 points by 6 years that I read as a suggestive long-run trajectory. The estimate attenuates and loses significance under within-region and within-division comparison and under relative-magnitude pre-trend violations, so I interpret it as suggestive of a causal effect under the design’s identifying assumptions rather than a firmly established magnitude. A supplementary instrumental-variables specification is consistent in sign but imprecise. A selection test does not detect changes in test participation, and channel analysis finds that observable health and economic indicators do not meaningfully mediate the effect, leaving the mechanism an open question for future research with individual-level data.
abstract_zh: 本文利用《平价医疗法案》下各州分阶段实施的医疗补助扩展政策，探究医疗可及性是否影响教育成就。基于2012–2024年县级面板数据（涵盖ACT成绩、保险覆盖率及健康指标），研究发现医疗补助扩展使县级ACT综合成绩提升0.50至0.85分（在控制规范中约为0.22个标准差）。采用Callaway与Sant'anna提出的异质性稳健估计量，得到简单汇总的平均处理效应（ATT）为0.79，表明该结果并非由禁止性比较造成的人为现象；事件研究支持平行趋势假设，且效应在6年内累积至约1.3分，可视为长期趋势的提示性证据。在区域内部及分区内部比较中，以及相对幅度事前趋势违反条件下，估计值减弱并失去显著性，因此本文将其解读为在设计识别假设下具有因果效应的提示性证据，而非确凿的效应量级。辅助工具变量估计在符号上一致但精度不足。选择检验未发现考试参与率变化，渠道分析表明可观测的健康与经济指标并未显著中介该效应，其作用机制有待未来基于个体层面数据的研究进一步探索。
title: Healthcare access and human capital: evidence from Medicaid expansion
title_zh: 医疗可及性与人力资本：来自医疗补助扩展的证据

abstract: How does district magnitude affect the quality of political representation? The Condorcet Jury Theorem (CJT) predicts that majority decisions improve with group size when members vote independently and are more likely than not to be correct. We test whether this aggregation mechanism applies to political decisions by examining whether larger legislative delegations better reflect constituent preferences. Nominal district magnitude often overstates the number of independent decision-makers because of party discipline. We therefore introduce effective district magnitude as a measure that more accurately captures the number of independently voting politicians within a constituency. Using 263 Swiss referenda (1992–2024) matched to parliamentary decisions, we find that the probability that a majority of a district’s delegation aligns with the preferences of its constituents increases with (effective) district magnitude, consistent with the CJT. The CJT aggregation mechanism closely predicts delegation-constituency congruence only for effective, not nominal, district magnitude. Our results provide empirical evidence that the CJT applies to representative democracies. They also show how party discipline limits the advantages of larger districts.
abstract_zh: 摘要 选区规模如何影响政治代表质量？孔多塞陪审团定理（CJT）预测，当成员独立投票且正确概率超过一半时，多数决策质量随群体规模提升。本文通过考察较大立法代表团是否更能反映选民偏好，检验这一聚合机制是否适用于政治决策。由于政党纪律约束，名义选区规模往往高估独立决策者数量。为此，我们引入有效选区规模这一指标，更精确地衡量选区内独立投票的政治家数量。基于1992-2024年263项瑞士公投与议会决策的匹配数据，我们发现选区代表团多数意见与选民偏好一致的概率随（有效）选区规模增加而上升，这与CJT预测相符。CJT聚合机制仅对有效选区规模（而非名义选区规模）能精准预测代表团与选民的契合度。本研究为CJT适用于代议制民主提供了实证证据，同时揭示了政党纪律如何限制大选区优势。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Party discipline, representation, and the condorcet jury theorem
title_zh: 党纪、代表性与孔多塞陪审团定理

abstract: Spatial autoregressive stochastic frontier models allow inefficiency to propagate across connected units. However, invertibility of the system matrix alone does not guarantee that exact spillover-corrected efficiency is admissible. If the inverse of the system matrix has negative entries, some non-negative inefficiency realizations imply negative total inefficiency and efficiency scores above one. Under non-negative spatial autoregressive parameters, we characterize the admissible parameter space for general non-negative spatial weighting matrices and extend the analysis to models with multiple weighting matrices. We also provide a practical sufficient condition and, for row-normalized multi-weight models, a simple necessary and sufficient restriction.
abstract_zh: 空间自回归随机前沿模型允许无效率在相连单元间传播。然而，系统矩阵的可逆性本身并不保证经溢出校正的精确效率具有可采纳性。若系统矩阵的逆矩阵含有负元素，则某些非负的无效率实现会导致总无效率为负，效率得分超过1。在非负空间自回归参数下，我们刻画了一般非负空间权重矩阵的可采纳参数空间，并将分析扩展到具有多个权重矩阵的模型。我们还提供了一个实用的充分条件，并针对行归一化的多权重模型，给出了一个简洁的必要且充分约束。
title: Estimating exact efficiency in multi-weight spatial autoregressive stochastic frontier models
title_zh: 多权重空间自回归随机前沿模型中精确效率的估计

abstract: Residential land prices are highly sensitive to new information, particularly when pollution disclosures highlight potential health risks. Following the 2020 disclosure of nationwide government survey results, extensive contamination from per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances, or PFAS, commonly known as “forever chemicals,” was revealed, leading to intensified media coverage and heightened public awareness. This study applies a staggered difference-in-differences approach to quantify the impact of PFAS pollution disclosures on Japanese residential land prices. Using property-level panel data from the Land Market Value Publication, we compare treated properties to control properties within varying distance radii. In the 5 km radius analysis, statistically significant average post-treatment declines range from approximately 1.3% when Tokyo is excluded to 2.4% when Osaka and Okinawa, which had received PFAS-related disclosures earlier, are also excluded. Across the distance-buffer specifications, dynamic event-study effects reach approximately 4.4–6.4% by the fourth year after disclosure. Notably, significant price declines emerged only after media coverage intensified around 2023, highlighting the critical role of information salience in translating environmental disclosures into market responses. A heterogeneity analysis suggests that high-value properties tend to exhibit larger and earlier price responses, consistent with buyers in higher-value market segments being more sensitive to environmental risk information. These findings indicate that pollution disclosures can reduce residential asset values, underscoring the economic costs of environmental information disclosure and the need for complementary policy measures to mitigate capitalized losses borne by affected property owners.
abstract_zh: 住宅用地价格对新信息高度敏感，尤其是当污染披露揭示潜在健康风险时。2020年全国政府调查结果公布后，全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFAS，俗称“永久化学品”）的广泛污染被曝光，导致媒体报道加剧和公众意识提升。本研究采用交错双重差分法，量化PFAS污染披露对日本住宅用地价格的影响。利用《地价公示》中的物业层面面板数据，我们在不同距离半径内将受处理物业与对照物业进行比较。在5公里半径分析中，统计上显著的平均处理后降幅约为1.3%（排除东京时）至2.4%（进一步排除此前已收到PFAS相关披露的大阪和冲绳时）。在不同距离缓冲区的设定下，动态事件研究效应在披露后第四年达到约4.4%至6.4%。值得注意的是，显著的价格下降仅在2023年左右媒体报道加剧后才出现，凸显了信息显著性在将环境披露转化为市场反应中的关键作用。异质性分析表明，高价值物业往往表现出更大且更早的价格反应，这与高价值市场细分中的买家对环境风险信息更为敏感一致。这些发现表明，污染披露可能降低住宅资产价值，凸显了环境信息披露的经济成本，以及需要采取补充政策措施来减轻受影响物业所有者承担的资本化损失。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
title: PFAS contamination disclosures and declining residential land prices in polluted areas of Japan
title_zh: PFAS污染披露与日本污染地区住宅用地价格下跌

abstract: This paper examines the long-term economic and cultural impacts of the postbellum migration of Southern white individuals to Brazil. Following the U.S. Civil War, thousands of individuals from the former Confederacy settled in a relatively poor region of São Paulo, contributing to its transformation into one of Brazil's wealthiest areas. I show that these migrants, though a small group, played a significant role in regional industrialization, particularly in cotton and textile industries, and in the mechanization of agriculture. Some of the migrants' cultural traits, such as Protestantism and English language use, persisted over time, largely due to the physical infrastructure they established. Unlike similar migrations within the U.S., I find no evidence of persistent legacies in terms of politics or racial inequality, emphasizing the role of local infrastructure in shaping the economic and cultural outcomes of immigration.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国内战后南方白人移民巴西的长期经济与文化影响。美国内战结束后，数千名前邦联成员定居于圣保罗一个相对贫困的地区，为该地区转变为巴西最富裕区域之一做出了贡献。我证明，这些移民虽人数不多，却在区域工业化中发挥了重要作用，尤其是在棉花和纺织产业以及农业机械化方面。移民的部分文化特征，如新教信仰和英语使用，随时间持续存在，这主要归功于他们所建立的有形基础设施。与美国境内类似迁移不同，我未发现政治或种族不平等方面的持久遗留影响，这强调了地方基础设施在塑造移民经济与文化成果中的关键作用。
title: Southern roots abroad: The long-run impact of the Confederate migration to Brazil
title_zh: 海外南方根源：美国邦联移民巴西的长期影响

abstract: This study examines the impact of exogenous institutional shocks on economic development by investigating the establishment of treaty ports in late Qing China (1840–1910). Forced open under unequal treaties imposed by foreign powers, these ports provide a quasi-natural experiment to identify the causal effects of openness on industrialization. We construct a novel county-level panel dataset from multiple historical archives, covering 1,752 counties with information on treaty port status, firm establishments, and firm scale measured by capital investment and industrial employment. Employing a staggered difference-in-differences (DiD) approach, we find that treaty port establishment significantly promoted firm agglomeration, as well as capital and labour accumulation. Mechanism analysis suggests that treaty ports spurred industrialization by expanding international trade, strengthening institutional control through foreign concessions, and building human capital through new-style schools. Heterogeneity analysis reveals stronger effects in light industries, for firms with foreign and private capital, and in coastal ports. Our findings suggest that treaty ports created the institutional and commercial gateways through which modern industry entered China.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过考察晚清时期（1840–1910年）通商口岸的设立，探讨外生制度冲击对经济发展的影响。这些口岸在外国列强强加的不平等条约下被迫开放，为识别开放对工业化的因果效应提供了准自然实验。我们基于多个历史档案构建了一个全新的县级面板数据集，涵盖1752个县，包含通商口岸状态、企业设立情况以及以资本投资和工业就业衡量的企业规模等信息。采用交错双重差分法，我们发现通商口岸的设立显著促进了企业集聚以及资本和劳动力的积累。机制分析表明，通商口岸通过扩大国际贸易、通过外国租界加强制度控制以及通过新式学堂积累人力资本，推动了工业化进程。异质性分析显示，通商口岸对轻工业、外资和私营企业以及沿海口岸的影响更为显著。我们的研究结果表明，通商口岸创造了制度与商业门户，现代工业正是通过这些门户进入中国。

title: Gateways to growth: the impact of ports on China’s early industrial development
title_zh: 增长的门户：港口对中国早期工业发展的影响

abstract: Why has internal migration remained low, even as advances in communication technologies have reduced information frictions in relocation decisions? This paper develops and estimates a spatial model of mobility that incorporates status quo bias in locational preferences, multilateral search frictions, and comoving regional unemployment. Using historical proxies for search frictions, we identify and recover county-level estimates of status quo bias across the United States. Status quo bias is spatially heterogeneous and highest in states containing large urban job centers. Translating these estimates into expected-utility, geographic-distance, and state-border equivalents indicates that variation in status quo bias generates migration frictions comparable to large geographic and institutional barriers. Status quo bias also exhibits strong persistence over time, a robust relationship to migration dynamics, and associations with a range of non-wage individual- and community-level correlates of locational preferences (e.g., housing, climate, and religious and political orientations). These patterns suggest that status quo bias partly reflects place-based preferences shaped by individuals’ residential histories.
abstract_zh: 为何在通信技术发展降低了搬迁决策中的信息摩擦的情况下，内部迁移率仍然保持低位？本文开发并估计了一个空间迁移模型，该模型融入了区位偏好中的现状偏见、多边搜索摩擦以及区域失业率的共同变动。利用历史代理变量来衡量搜索摩擦，我们识别并恢复了美国县级层面的现状偏见估计值。现状偏见在空间上呈现异质性，且在包含大型城市就业中心的州中最为显著。将这些估计值转换为期望效用、地理距离和州界等效值表明，现状偏见的差异所产生的迁移摩擦可与大型地理和制度障碍相媲美。现状偏见还表现出强烈的时间持续性，与迁移动态存在稳健关联，并与一系列非工资性的个体及社区层面的区位偏好相关因素（如住房、气候、宗教和政治倾向）相关联。这些模式表明，现状偏见部分反映了由个体居住历史塑造的基于地方的偏好。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 248
title: On migration gravity with status quo bias and job search frictions
title_zh: 带有现状偏好和工作搜寻摩擦的移民引力模型

abstract: We propose a novel game, the Dictatorial Public Goods Game , to study the interplay between collective resource generation and centralized provision of public goods. After making choices in a standard Voluntary Contribution Mechanism (VCM), one player is selected from the group to administrate the contributions: either provide the public good or expropriate the collected resources for personal gain. We find that adding this centralized mechanism reduces efficiency compared to the standard VCM. Although higher contributions increase the material incentive to expropriate, they lead to more provision. Thus, pro-social choices in the contribution and in the provision stages act as complements, reflecting the generation of social capital in the group. Administrators tend to provide more when the statutory default is expropriation rather than provision. This counter status-quo effect is in line with the standard provision-maintenance gap in the literature, but is not explained by the theoretical arguments typically invoked to explain such framing effects.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的博弈——独裁性公共品博弈，用以研究集体资源生成与公共品集中供给之间的相互作用。在标准自愿贡献机制（VCM）中做出选择后，从群体中选出一名玩家来管理贡献：要么提供公共品，要么将收集的资源据为己有。我们发现，与标准VCM相比，加入这一集中机制会降低效率。尽管更高的贡献增加了侵占的物质激励，但它们反而导致了更多的供给。因此，贡献阶段和供给阶段的亲社会行为互为补充，反映了群体中社会资本的生成。当法定默认设置为侵占而非供给时，管理者倾向于提供更多。这种反现状效应与文献中标准的供给-维护缺口一致，但无法用通常用于解释此类框架效应的理论论点来解释。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 248
title: The dictatorial public goods game
title_zh: 独裁公共品博弈

abstract: We explore implications of social status concerns for redistribution, income inequality, and growth in a political economy framework. Salience of such concerns leads to a propagation mechanism, whereby initial income inequality and reduced willingness to redistribute income reinforce each other, potentially giving rise to multiple steady states. An extension illustrates the possibility of a high redistribution cum low inequality steady state resulting in a higher steady‐state income level. Some of the model features are shown to be consistent with empirical regularities as reflected in survey data on social status attitudes.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文在政治经济学框架下探讨社会地位关注对再分配、收入不平等及经济增长的影响。此类关注的显著性会引发一种传导机制，其中初始收入不平等与再分配意愿的降低相互强化，可能形成多重稳态。扩展分析表明，高再分配与低不平等并存的稳态可能导致更高的稳态收入水平。模型的部分特征与社会地位态度调查数据所反映的实证规律具有一致性。
title: Social Status, Inequality, and Redistribution
title_zh: 社会地位、不平等与再分配

abstract: This paper studies the introduction of causal conditional heteroskedasticity in noncausal autoregressive (AR) models. We demonstrate that, in this framework, large shocks to the innovation process driving the GARCH error term of a noncausal AR model result in heightened volatility immediately before and after a bubble crash. The non-coincidence of the σ -fields generated by past observations and past values of the GARCH process makes statistical inference nonstandard. In particular, the full quasi-maximum likelihood estimator (QMLE) is generally inconsistent. We investigate the asymptotic properties of three-step weighted least squares estimators of the AR coefficient and the QMLE of the volatility parameters. Our findings are illustrated by Monte Carlo experiments and an empirical application to financial data.
abstract_zh: 本文研究在非因果自回归（AR）模型中引入因果条件异方差性的方法。我们证明，在该框架下，驱动非因果AR模型GARCH误差项的创新过程中的大幅冲击，会导致泡沫崩溃前后波动性显著加剧。由于过去观测值生成的σ域与GARCH过程过去值生成的σ域不重合，统计推断变得非标准。具体而言，完全拟极大似然估计量（QMLE）通常不一致。我们研究了AR系数的三步加权最小二乘估计量以及波动率参数的QMLE的渐近性质。通过蒙特卡洛实验和对金融数据的实证应用，本文验证了上述发现。
title: Noncausal AR processes driven by causal GARCH volatility
title_zh: 因果GARCH波动驱动的非因果AR过程

abstract: In the spatial model of voting, the yolk and LP (linear programming) yolk are important solution concepts for predicting outcomes for a committee of voters. McKelvey and Tovey showed that the LP yolk provides a lower bound approximation for the size of the yolk and there has been considerable debate on whether the LP yolk is a good approximation of the yolk. The problem was partially resolved for arbitrarily large committees (as the number of voters goes to infinity) but remains open when there are few voters, which is standard for most committees. In this paper, we show that for an odd number of voters in a two-dimensional space, the yolk radius is at most twice the size of the LP yolk radius and we show that this bound is tight—there exists a family of instances where the LP yolk radius will differ from the yolk radius by a factor arbitrarily close to 2. We also show that (1) even in this setting, the LP yolk center can be arbitrarily far away from the yolk center (relative to the radius of the yolk) and (2) for all other settings (an even number of voters or in dimension k \ge 3), the LP yolk can be arbitrarily small relative to the yolk. Thus, in general, the LP yolk can be an arbitrarily poor approximation of the yolk.
abstract_zh: 在空间投票模型中，蛋黄（yolk）与线性规划蛋黄（LP yolk）是预测委员会投票结果的重要解概念。McKelvey与Tovey证明线性规划蛋黄为蛋黄规模提供了下界近似，但关于线性规划蛋黄能否有效近似蛋黄的问题一直存在激烈争论。该问题在委员会规模趋于无穷大时已得到部分解决，但在标准委员会常见的少量投票者情形下仍悬而未决。本文证明：在二维空间中奇数投票者情形下，蛋黄半径至多为线性规划蛋黄半径的两倍，且该上界是紧的——存在实例族使得线性规划蛋黄半径与蛋黄半径的比值可任意趋近于2。我们同时证明：（1）即便在此设定下，线性规划蛋黄中心与蛋黄中心的距离（相对于蛋黄半径）可任意大；（2）在其他所有设定中（偶数投票者或维度k≥3），线性规划蛋黄相对于蛋黄可任意小。因此，一般而言，线性规划蛋黄对蛋黄的近似效果可能极差。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: On the approximability of the yolk by the LP yolk in the spatial model of voting
title_zh: 空间投票模型中蛋黄由线性规划蛋黄逼近的可近似性

abstract: We model and experimentally test the relationship between a firm’s reputation and its governance when firms can repair reputation damage through reform. Our model shows that conditions for establishing a reputation depend on whether control of firm operations is delegated to professional managers. Moreover, although the option to reform always dilutes firms’ incentive to commit to reputable behavior, delegation ameliorates the dilution. We assess the robustness of our model to behavioral deviations from optimal behavior through a laboratory experiment. The results of this experiment are directionally consistent with the model’s predictions.
abstract_zh: 我们构建模型并通过实验检验了企业声誉与其治理之间的关系，前提是企业能够通过改革修复声誉损害。模型显示，建立声誉的条件取决于企业运营控制权是否委托给职业经理人。此外，尽管改革选项始终削弱企业承诺声誉行为的激励，但委托管理能缓解这种削弱效应。我们通过实验室实验评估了模型对偏离最优行为的行为偏差的稳健性。实验结果在方向上与模型预测一致。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 248
title: Governance, reputation, crises and recovery: An experiment
title_zh: 治理、声誉、危机与复苏：一项实验研究

abstract: International trade depends on the expectation that courts will protect commercial interests when disputes arise. With the growing number of international conflicts, it is crucial to know whether this expectation is met in practice. We examine the effect of the 2014 annexation of Crimea on the enforcement rate of foreign decisions by Russian and Ukrainian judges. We assemble novel data on the entire universe of Russian and Ukrainian court decisions concerning the enforcement of foreign decisions resolving cross-border commercial disputes. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that the enforcement rate of Ukrainian (Russian) decisions in Russia (Ukraine) fell by 26% (33%) after the annexation. We show that courts increasingly justified refusals through discretionary legal grounds and undue-notification claims. Our findings provide the first causal evidence that international conflict affects both judicial decision-making and compliance with commercial treaties.
abstract_zh: 国际贸易依赖于一种预期，即当纠纷发生时，法院会保护商业利益。随着国际冲突日益增多，了解这一预期在实践中是否得到满足至关重要。我们研究了2014年克里米亚被吞并事件对俄罗斯和乌克兰法官执行外国判决率的影响。我们收集了关于俄罗斯和乌克兰法院处理跨境商业纠纷中外国判决执行问题的全部判决的新数据。采用双重差分法，我们发现吞并事件后，乌克兰（俄罗斯）判决在俄罗斯（乌克兰）的执行率下降了26%（33%）。研究表明，法院越来越多地通过自由裁量的法律理由和不当通知主张来拒绝执行。我们的研究首次提供了因果证据，证明国际冲突会影响司法决策以及商业条约的遵守情况。
title: The impact of international conflict on cross-border commercial dispute resolution
title_zh: 国际冲突对跨境商事争议解决的影响

abstract: The gender gap in non‐agricultural employment in developing countries is concentrated among rural married workers. Within‐family specialization is central: Married women spend more time on home production, work fewer market hours, and are less likely to incur fixed costs of entering non‐agriculture. We develop a general equilibrium Roy model with joint household decisions, sector‐neutral gender labor wedges, and entry barriers. Calibrated to China in 2010, the model reproduces the observed gender employment gap. Gender labor wedges explain about 80% of it, amplified by within‐family specialization, while changing entry barriers account for its widening from 2000 to 2010.
abstract_zh: 摘要 发展中国家非农就业中的性别差距主要集中在农村已婚劳动者群体。家庭内部分工是核心因素：已婚女性在家务劳动上投入更多时间，市场工作时间更少，且更不愿承担进入非农部门所需的固定成本。我们构建了一个包含联合家庭决策、部门中性性别劳动楔子及进入壁垒的一般均衡罗伊模型。基于2010年中国数据的校准结果显示，该模型能够复现观测到的性别就业差距。其中，性别劳动楔子解释了约80%的差距，并通过家庭内部分工机制被放大；而进入壁垒的变化则解释了2000年至2010年间该差距的扩大趋势。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为中国2010年数据，模型校准基于中国，核心应用解释中国性别就业差距
title: Home Production and Gender Gap in Structural Change
title_zh: 家庭生产与结构变迁中的性别差距

abstract: This paper investigates how the agricultural cycle influences protest behavior in Kenya from 2000 to 2019. Using satellite data to identify the crop cycle and local harvest periods at the lowest available administrative level (wards) and geocoded protest records, we find that protest activity does not decline during the harvest period but increases with a temporal lag. A dynamic difference-in-differences specification shows that protest activity gradually rises in the two to three months following harvest, peaking around the onset of the subsequent agricultural cycle. These patterns are consistent with theories of opportunity costs and seasonal scarcity. While the opportunity costs of protest participation are highest during harvest periods, they decline thereafter and coincide with the lean season, when household food stocks become exhausted. These findings are robust across empirical specifications and contribute to a deeper understanding of the temporal dynamics of unrest in agrarian settings. They also highlight the importance of timing in the design of rural development and conflict prevention policies.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了2000年至2019年间农业周期如何影响肯尼亚的抗议行为。利用卫星数据识别最低行政层级（选区）的作物周期与当地收获期，并结合地理编码的抗议记录，我们发现抗议活动在收获期间并未减少，反而在时间滞后效应下有所增加。动态双重差分模型显示，抗议活动在收获后两至三个月内逐渐上升，并在后续农业周期开始时达到峰值。这些模式与机会成本及季节性稀缺理论相吻合：尽管收获期参与抗议的机会成本最高，但此后机会成本下降，恰逢家庭粮食储备耗尽的淡季。上述发现在不同实证设定中均保持稳健，有助于深化对农业社会动荡时间动态的理解，同时凸显了农村发展与冲突预防政策设计中时机选择的重要性。
title: Predictable patterns of protest: The impact of agricultural cycles on social unrest in Kenya
title_zh: 可预测的抗议模式：农业周期对肯尼亚社会动荡的影响

abstract: We revisit fiscal sustainability through the lens of the government’s budget constraint. What constrains fiscal policy is not the stock of outstanding liabilities per se, but the fiscal cost of servicing debt. Using two centuries of U.S. fiscal data (1800–2023) and a long-run panel of advanced economies, we show that primary surpluses are systematically more closely associated with debt-service burdens, while debt ratios lose explanatory power when debt service is taken into account. Fiscal responses intensify when financing conditions deteriorate, specifically when the interest-growth differential is positive. We rationalize these findings using a simple flow-based framework in which debt stabilization depends on the responsiveness of fiscal surpluses to financing pressures. The results suggest that fiscal sustainability depends less on debt thresholds than on financing regimes and governments’ ability to absorb debt-service burdens.
abstract_zh: 我们通过政府预算约束的视角重新审视财政可持续性问题。制约财政政策的并非未偿债务存量本身，而是偿债的财政成本。基于美国两个世纪（1800-2023年）的财政数据以及发达经济体的长期面板数据，我们表明：基本盈余与偿债负担之间存在系统性更强的关联，而当考虑偿债成本时，债务比率对财政行为的解释力显著下降。当融资条件恶化时——特别是当利率-增长率差值为正时——财政政策反应会显著增强。我们通过一个基于流量分析的简单框架对这些发现进行理论解释，该框架认为债务稳定取决于财政盈余对融资压力的响应程度。研究结果表明，财政可持续性更取决于融资机制及政府吸收偿债负担的能力，而非债务阈值本身。
title: From Stocks to Flows: Debt Service and Fiscal Sustainability
title_zh: 从存量到流量：债务服务与财政可持续性

abstract: This study provides a socio-ecological and bioeconomic analysis of their multifunctional contribution to the sustainability of Marrakech, a city under strong natural pressures (climatic, etc) and human pressures (pollution, etc). Empirically, we quantify ecosystem services (thermal and hydrological regulation, sequestration and storage of pollutant gases ‘CO₂, CO, O₃, NO₂, SO₂, PM₂.₅ and PM₁₀’; O2 production…), as well as the associated socio-economic benefits. A mixed methodology combines hyperspectral remote sensing, GIS, bioeconomic modeling (i-Tree Eco), and field surveys (measurements; interviews using interview guides and questionnaires). A PCA analysis allows us to distinguish five ecological profiles among the studied sites. We also correlate managerial performance and governance with environmental effectiveness. These findings point to an ecological hierarchy, in particular, large wooded spaces such as the Palmeraie act as major carbon sinks (53760 t CO₂/year), and offer exceptional hydrological regulation (runoff reduction > 98%), On the other hand, the small gardens play a role in providing filtration of pollutants and cooling. Moreover, mathematical modeling demonstrates that governance mechanisms explain 64.26% of the variability in green space quality (R² = 0.646), highlighting that stakeholder participation, resource mobilization, and monitoring-evaluation are just as decisive as biophysical characteristics. Overall, the quantitative results confirm the pronounced multifunctionality of these areas, and highlight the significance of governance processes, efficiency, effectiveness, and satisfaction as major factors affecting the ecological performance of these areas. Finally, this research provides a new perspective on urban green areas by redefining them as a means of urban adaptation and environmental justice in Marrakech and similar cities.
abstract_zh: 本研究从社会生态与生物经济视角，分析了马拉喀什市多功能绿地对可持续性的贡献，该城市面临强烈自然压力（如气候）和人为压力（如污染）。实证上，我们量化了生态系统服务（热力与水文调节、污染物气体‘CO₂、CO、O₃、NO₂、SO₂、PM₂.₅和PM₁₀’的固存与储存、O₂产生等）及相关社会经济效益。采用混合方法，结合高光谱遥感、GIS、生物经济模型（i-Tree Eco）及实地调查（测量；使用访谈指南和问卷的访谈）。主成分分析（PCA）使我们能够区分研究地点中的五种生态特征。我们还将管理绩效和治理与环境有效性相关联。研究结果揭示了生态层级，特别是如帕尔默赖（Palmeraie）等大型林地作为主要碳汇（每年53760吨CO₂），并提供卓越的水文调节（径流减少>98%）；而小型花园则发挥污染物过滤和降温作用。此外，数学模型表明，治理机制解释了绿地质量变异的64.26%（R² = 0.646），强调利益相关者参与、资源动员和监测评估与生物物理特征同样具有决定性作用。总体而言，定量结果证实了这些区域显著的多功能性，并凸显治理过程、效率、有效性和满意度作为影响其生态表现的主要因素的重要性。最后，本研究通过将城市绿地重新定义为马拉喀什及类似城市中城市适应和环境正义的手段，提供了新的视角。
title: Public green spaces for urban sustainability: A quantitative socio-ecological analysis of impacts in Marrakech, Morocco
title_zh: 城市可持续性的公共绿地：摩洛哥马拉喀什影响的定量社会生态分析

abstract: European mountain areas have been historically shaped by traditional pastoral practices, creating culturally, ecologically, and visually valuable traditional landscapes. Over the past decades, these landscapes have faced profound transformations due to the decline of pastoralism and the rapid development of tourism. This paper applies a modified DPSIR framework, referred to as the DRSIR model, to present driving forces, local reactions, landscape state changes, impacts, and responses related to transformations of pastoral landscape in European mountain regions. The aim of this paper is to present a conceptual synthesis of these transformations based on a literature review and structured using the DRSIR framework. The conceptual synthesis enabled the identification of three landscape transformation models: Co-presence, Sequence, and Abandonment. These models reflect varying degrees of interaction between pastoralism and tourism. Co-presence allows for sustainable coexistence or cooperation between traditional pastoralism and tourism which allows the preservation of traditional landscape features. Sequence models illustrate transitions where one function succeeds or suppresses the other, and abandonment reflects the decline of pastoral practices and tourism, often leading to afforestation and loss of landscape and cultural values. The essay highlights landscape consequences of these trajectories. Management responses, guided by legal protection, agri-environmental policies, and sustainable tourism initiatives, can either prevent abandonment or mitigate negative impacts, shaping future landscape scenarios. The DRSIR framework provides a comprehensive lens for understanding these dynamics, supporting spatial planning and landscape management by enabling the identification of dominant relationships between tourism and pastoralism in different mountain regions. Maintaining the evolutionary continuity of traditional landscapes while integrating pastoralism and tourism functions emerges as a key strategy for preserving European mountain landscapes.
abstract_zh: 欧洲山区历史上深受传统牧业实践的影响，形成了具有文化、生态和视觉价值的传统景观。近几十年来，由于牧业衰退和旅游业快速发展，这些景观经历了深刻变革。本文采用改进的DPSIR框架（即DRSIR模型），系统呈现了欧洲山区牧场景观转型相关的驱动力、地方响应、景观状态变化、影响及应对措施。研究旨在基于文献综述，运用DRSIR框架对这些转型进行概念性综合。该概念综合识别出三种景观转型模式：共存模式、序列模式与废弃模式。这些模式反映了牧业与旅游业之间不同程度的互动关系。共存模式允许传统牧业与旅游业实现可持续共存或合作，从而保留传统景观特征；序列模式呈现一种功能取代或抑制另一种功能的过渡过程；废弃模式则反映牧业与旅游业的双重衰退，常导致森林扩张及景观与文化价值的丧失。本文重点阐述了这些发展轨迹的景观后果。在法律保护、农业环境政策及可持续旅游倡议指导下的管理应对措施，既能防止景观废弃，也能减轻负面影响，从而塑造未来景观格局。DRSIR框架为理解这些动态机制提供了全面视角，通过识别不同山区牧业与旅游业之间的主导关系，支持空间规划与景观管理。在整合牧业与旅游功能的同时，维持传统景观的演化连续性，成为保护欧洲山区景观的关键策略。
title: Balancing pastoral heritage and tourism – A DRSIR perspective on landscape transformation in European mountains
title_zh: 平衡牧区遗产与旅游业——基于DRSIR视角的欧洲山地景观转型研究

abstract: This study examines how negative performance feedback is associated with real earnings management (REM) and how firm-level market power conditions that relationship. Building on the behavioural theory of the firm and threat-rigidity theory, we argue that performance shortfalls direct organizational attention towards responses that are immediate, proximate, and risk-acceptable. REM fits this behavioural profile because it can alter reported outcomes through real operating decisions while remaining less directly visible than many accounting choices or illegal actions. Using 23,629 firm-year observations for publicly listed U.S. firms from 1992 to 2018, we find that larger performance shortfalls are associated with higher REM. We also find that this relationship weakens as market power increases. Additional analyses support a cautious interpretation: the evidence is more consistent with shortfall-driven opportunistic REM than with a purely strategic or efficiency-enhancing explanation, although standard REM proxies do not directly identify managerial intent. The findings contribute to applied research on firm behaviour under performance pressure by showing that market power can alter the way firms respond to adverse feedback through real operating decisions.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了负面绩效反馈如何影响真实盈余管理（REM），以及企业层面的市场势力如何调节这一关系。基于企业行为理论与威胁-刚性理论，我们提出：绩效缺口会将组织注意力导向即时、直接且风险可接受的应对措施。真实盈余管理符合这一行为特征——它通过实际经营决策改变报告业绩，同时相较于诸多会计选择或违法行为具有更低的直接可见性。基于1992年至2018年间美国上市公司23,629个公司-年度观测值，本研究发现：绩效缺口越大，真实盈余管理程度越高；市场势力越强，该正向关联越弱。进一步分析支持审慎解读：证据更倾向于表明绩效缺口驱动机会主义型真实盈余管理，而非纯粹战略或效率提升型解释——尽管标准真实盈余管理代理变量无法直接识别管理层意图。本研究通过揭示市场势力如何改变企业通过实际经营决策应对负面反馈的方式，为绩效压力下企业行为的应用研究提供了新见解。
title: The inconvenient truth of problemistic search: real earnings management
title_zh: 问题搜索的不便真相：真实盈余管理

abstract: Bilateral investment treaties (BITs) are widely acknowledged as instruments for attracting inward foreign direct investment (IFDI), yet their effectiveness remains contested. By using a sample of 64 countries along the Belt and Road Initiative, this study employs the Quadratic Assignment Procedure to analyse the impact of BITs on IFDI and further explores how these effects vary across IFDI subnetworks with distinct structural characteristics. Our analysis yields three key findings. First, the effect of BITs on IFDI declined over time – it was strong between 2012 and 2016 but weakened after 2017 due to the emergence of alternative institutions and evolving geopolitical factors. Second, the impact of formal BIT protections is prominent in low-cohesion networks. However, in high-cohesion systems, densely connected networks rely more on informal enforcement mechanisms. Third, strong expropriation clauses enhance investment, whereas investor-state dispute settlement provisions have a limited effect. These results indicate that policymakers should pursue targeted BIT strategies, prioritizing partners with central network positions or those embedded in highly active, low-cohesion communities; furthermore, a pronounced focus on strengthening substantive protections over indiscriminate treaty expansion is suggested. By linking clause-level treaty designs to network characteristics, this study contributes to a more nuanced understanding of heterogeneous IFDI outcomes.
abstract_zh: 双边投资条约（BITs）被广泛视为吸引外商直接投资（IFDI）的工具，但其有效性仍存争议。本研究以"一带一路"倡议沿线64个国家为样本，采用二次指派程序分析BITs对IFDI的影响，并进一步探讨这些效应如何随具有不同结构特征的IFDI子网络而变化。分析得出三项关键发现：第一，BITs对IFDI的影响随时间递减——2012年至2016年间效应显著，但2017年后因替代性制度兴起及地缘政治因素演变而减弱；第二，正式BIT保护机制在低凝聚力网络中作用突出，但在高凝聚力系统中，密集关联网络更依赖非正式执行机制；第三，强有力的征收条款能促进投资，而投资者-国家争端解决条款效果有限。这些结果表明，政策制定者应采取针对性BIT策略，优先选择处于网络中心位置或嵌入高活跃度、低凝聚力社群中的伙伴国；同时建议重点强化实质性保护条款而非盲目扩大条约范围。通过将条款级条约设计与网络特征相联系，本研究有助于更细致地理解IFDI的异质性结果。
title: Connecting the dots: how bilateral investment treaty networks influence inward foreign direct investment
title_zh: 连接点：双边投资条约网络如何影响内向外国直接投资

abstract: This study develops a global stochastic computable general equilibrium (CGE) model to evaluate trigger mechanisms and coverage rates for an international joint grain reserve among China, Japan, and South Korea. Framing the reserve as a cooperative risk-sharing institution with public-good characteristics, it links release-rule design to incentive compatibility and institutional sustainability. Unlike prior studies emphasizing reserve size and contribution rules, we examine how release triggers interact with probabilistic shock distributions. We compare VaR-based triggers at 70–95% confidence levels with uniform thresholds of 2.5–20% under 500 correlated productivity-shock paths. Results show that VaR-based triggers generate consistent welfare gains, risk reduction, and complete Pareto improvements. Uniform triggers produce more asymmetric outcomes; at the 10% threshold, Japan and South Korea benefit while China incurs welfare losses. For VaR designs, the optimal coverage rate is approximately 75%, since increasing coverage to 100% brings only marginal additional gains. Excessively aggressive trigger–coverage combinations can weaken performance by accelerating reserve depletion under extreme shocks. Overall, an 80% VaR trigger with 75–100% coverage provides the strongest stabilization effect and more balanced welfare distribution, supporting voluntary participation and long-term cooperation
abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一个全球随机可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型，以评估中日韩三国国际联合粮食储备的触发机制与覆盖率。通过将粮食储备界定为具有公共品属性的合作型风险分担制度，本研究将释放规则设计与激励相容性及制度可持续性相关联。与以往侧重储备规模与出资规则的研究不同，我们重点考察释放触发机制如何与概率性冲击分布相互作用。在500条关联生产率冲击路径下，我们比较了置信水平70%-95%的VaR触发机制与2.5%-20%的统一阈值触发机制。结果表明：VaR触发机制能产生持续福利改善、风险降低及完全帕累托改进；统一阈值触发机制则呈现更显著的非对称效应——在10%阈值下，日韩两国获益而中国遭受福利损失。就VaR设计而言，最优覆盖率约为75%，因将覆盖率提升至100%仅带来边际增益。过度激进的触发-覆盖率组合可能因极端冲击下加速储备消耗而削弱绩效。总体而言，80% VaR触发机制配合75%-100%覆盖率能实现最强稳定效应与更均衡的福利分配，从而支撑自愿参与与长期合作。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Rethinking release rules for international grain reserves under production risk
title_zh: 生产风险下国际粮食储备释放规则的再思考

abstract: We introduce a new family of power indices for nodes in graphs with classes. We provide an axiomatic characterization of this family and prove the independence of the axioms. Furthermore, we show that these indices coincide with the Shapley values of a family of subadditive transferable-utility games defined on such graphs. These normative results yield a general framework for quantifying structural influence in complex networks. In particular, we identify the normative conditions under which power in technological sharing networks can be represented by our family of indices. Importantly, the proposed axiomatic framework also applies to influence flows that generate negative effects.
abstract_zh: 我们针对带有类别属性的图节点引入了一类新的权力指数族，给出了该指数族的公理化刻画，并证明了各公理之间的独立性。进一步地，我们证明这些指数与定义在此类图上的次可加可转移效用博弈族中的沙普利值一致。这些规范性结论为量化复杂网络中的结构性影响提供了通用框架。特别地，我们识别出技术共享网络中权力可由本指数族表征的规范性条件。重要的是，所提出的公理化框架同样适用于产生负效应的影响力流动。
title: Power in graphs with classes
title_zh: 具有类别的图中的权力

abstract: In dynamic multisector economies, the planner’s optimal capital allocation can serve to minimize the aggregate impact of shocks cascading through nonlinear production networks. We show analytically in a simplified model that, under complementarity and if risk aversion is not too low, (i) optimal capital allocation under uncertainty involves deliberately over-investing, relative to the deterministic optimum, in upstream sectors in order to mitigate severe economic downturns; (ii) this strategy can reduce the average level of consumption and give rise to a high welfare cost of business cycles. Deploying novel deep-learning techniques in a general environment, we show quantitatively that: (iii) the ergodic distribution of the simulated nonlinear economy features higher mean capital levels in key upstream sectors, lower mean levels of macroeconomic aggregates, realistic aggregate volatility, and a welfare cost of business cycles two orders of magnitude larger than in standard one-sector models.
abstract_zh: 在动态多部门经济中，规划者的最优资本配置能够最小化通过非线性生产网络级联放大的冲击对总体经济的影响。我们在简化模型中通过解析推导表明，在要素互补性且风险厌恶程度不太低的情况下：（i）不确定性下的最优资本配置策略会相对于确定性最优状态，有意对上游部门进行过度投资，以缓解严重的经济衰退；（ii）该策略可能降低平均消费水平，并导致商业周期产生高昂的福利成本。通过运用新型深度学习技术于一般化环境，我们定量分析发现：（iii）模拟非线性经济的遍历分布呈现关键上游部门平均资本水平更高、宏观经济总量均值更低、总体波动率符合现实特征，且商业周期福利成本比标准单部门模型高出两个数量级。
title: Planning Against Disasters in Dynamic Production Networks
title_zh: 动态生产网络中的灾害应对规划

abstract: Cross-cultural databases are bounded by expert coding and missing observations. The Ethnographic Atlas (EA) codes 1,265 societies on 104 variables, with about 960 societies observed per variable on average, and the Standard Cross-Cultural Sample (SCCS) codes 186 societies on 1,717 variables, with about 105 observed per variable. I use a large language model and the 2,564-motif Berezkin catalogue to extract coverage, what motifs discuss, and stance, what positions they take. Stance, what a motif says, is strongest. Across 26 researcher-designed dimensions, stance is multidimensional (leading component 15.1%, matching ethnographic data) and largely independent of the coverage complexity gradient. On the two dimensions with direct human benchmarks, stance agrees on whether challenged characters succeed (kappa = 0.64) and whether antisocial behavior succeeds or is punished (kappa = 0.49), near the strongest available human benchmark of kappa about 0.57. Among 20 dimensions with no database equivalent, 18 have reliable group-level stance ratios across three runs (ICC >= 0.5$). Nine stance-outcome links survive continent fixed effects, false-discovery correction, and a complexity control, led by outsiders contact for lower GDP and emotional expression for higher female labor participation. Coverage succeeds differently. Across 1,805 usable codebook concepts, coverage predicts 65 of 88 EA variables and detects signal in 35 of 46 pooled SCCS domains, but this information concentrates in one factor. The first principal component explains 43% of score variance versus 15% in EA data, and the resulting complexity index predicts GDP within continents (R^2 = 0.55). Folklore measurement is one-dimensional only when the question is coverage. Researcher-defined concepts become measurable across 958 societies for $0.03 to $1.70.
abstract_zh: 跨文化数据库受限于专家编码与观测缺失。《民族志图谱》（EA）对1265个社会的104个变量进行编码，平均每个变量约960个观测值；《标准跨文化样本》（SCCS）对186个社会的1717个变量进行编码，平均每个变量约105个观测值。我利用大语言模型与包含2564个母题的别列兹金目录，提取了覆盖范围（即母题讨论的内容）与立场（即母题所持的立场）。其中，立场（即母题表述的内容）最为显著。在26个研究者设计的维度中，立场呈现多维性（主成分解释方差15.1%，与民族志数据匹配），且基本独立于覆盖范围的复杂度梯度。在具有直接人类基准的两个维度上，立场在受挑战角色是否成功（kappa=0.64）以及反社会行为是否成功或受惩罚（kappa=0.49）上达成一致，接近现有最强人类基准（kappa约0.57）。在20个无数据库对应维度的维度中，18个维度在三次运行中具有可靠的群体层面立场比率（ICC≥0.5）。九个立场-结果关联在控制大陆固定效应、错误发现率校正及复杂度控制后依然显著，其中外部接触与较低GDP、情感表达与较高女性劳动参与率关联最强。覆盖范围则以不同方式发挥作用。在1805个可用编码手册概念中，覆盖范围预测了88个EA变量中的65个，并在46个合并SCCS领域中的35个中检测到信号，但这一信息集中于单一因子。第一主成分解释43%的得分方差（EA数据中为15%），由此产生的复杂度指数可预测大陆内部的GDP（R²=0.55）。只有当问题聚焦于覆盖范围时，民俗测量才呈现单维性。研究者定义的概念可在958个社会中以0.03至1.70美元的成本实现可测量性。
title: What Oral Traditions Are About and What They Say
title_zh: 口头传统的内容与表达

abstract: Full-day school programs aim to promote development by improving students’ learning outcomes. We estimate the impact of Peru’s full-day secondary school reform, Jornada Escolar Completa (JEC), on higher education attainment. Using data from the Young Lives Study, we construct a grouped-sibling sample linking younger siblings who could attend JEC secondary schools with their older siblings who did not attend. The identification strategy relies on within-household variation and a difference-in-differences framework comparing changes in higher education attainment between households affected and not affected by the JEC program. We find that JEC increases the likelihood of pursuing higher education, with effects concentrated in technical rather than university studies. Our findings also suggest larger gains among students from disadvantaged backgrounds, pointing to the potential of JEC to narrow inequalities in access to higher education. Time-use data show that JEC students remain engaged in learning, with no increase in absenteeism or decline in study time at home. Rather, they compensate for longer school days by cutting back on leisure and work activities. Overall, the evidence indicates that the JEC program increases educational attainment, with extended instructional time likely being one contributing factor among other improvements in school resources. JEC’s effects on upward mobility, however, may remain limited without complementary measures that ease access to university education.
abstract_zh: 全日制学校项目旨在通过提升学生的学习成果来促进发展。我们评估了秘鲁的全日制中学改革——“完整学校日”（JEC）对高等教育入学率的影响。利用“青年生活研究”数据，我们构建了一个分组兄弟姐妹样本，将可能就读JEC中学的弟弟妹妹与未就读该项目的哥哥姐姐进行配对。识别策略依赖于家庭内部差异，并采用双重差分框架，比较受JEC项目影响与未受影响家庭之间高等教育入学率的变化。我们发现，JEC提高了追求高等教育的可能性，其效应主要集中在技术类而非大学类学习上。我们的研究结果还表明，来自不利背景的学生获益更大，这指向JEC在缩小高等教育入学机会不平等方面具有潜力。时间使用数据显示，JEC学生持续参与学习，缺勤率未增加，在家学习时间也未减少。相反，他们通过减少休闲和工作活动来补偿更长的在校时间。总体而言，证据表明JEC项目提升了教育成就，其中延长教学时间可能是学校资源其他改进中的一个促成因素。然而，若无配套措施便利大学入学途径，JEC对向上流动的影响可能仍然有限。
title: Full-day school programs and higher education: Evidence from Peru
title_zh: 全日制学校项目与高等教育：来自秘鲁的证据

abstract: Institutional and individual investors evaluate private market opportunities systematically differently, even facing identical choices. In a survey experiment, 593 institutional and 445 individual investors assess venture capital fund profiles with independently randomized GP characteristics. Institutions heavily weight past fund performance, consistent with risk-averse investor demand calibrated to VC markets. Individuals largely ignore performance, favoring educational credentials instead. A follow-up experiment identifies two independent mechanisms: individuals lack awareness that VC performance persists and discount quality signals for funds they perceive as inaccessible. Performance-based selection alone reduces individuals’ expected returns by approximately 7%, accounting for 20% of the return gap with professionals.
abstract_zh: 机构投资者与个人投资者在面对相同的私募市场机会时，其评估方式存在系统性差异。在一项调查实验中，593名机构投资者与445名个人投资者对风险投资基金概况进行了评估，其中普通合伙人特征被独立随机化。机构投资者高度重视过往基金业绩，这与风险投资市场中风险规避型投资者需求相吻合。相比之下，个人投资者则基本忽视业绩表现，转而偏好教育背景资质。后续实验揭示了两个独立机制：个人投资者既缺乏对风险投资业绩持续性的认知，又对自认为难以触及的基金质量信号持折扣态度。仅基于业绩的选择机制便使个人投资者的预期收益降低约7%，这解释了其与专业人士之间约20%的收益差距。
title: Investor expertise and private investment selection
title_zh: 投资者专长与私人投资选择

abstract: Policy‑triggered land-use/land-cover (LULC) change is a critical global challenge, particularly in tropical regions, where agricultural expansion and investment policies are accelerating forest loss and ecosystem degradation. In the study area, most prior studies emphasized biophysical dynamics, with limited attention to how land policies, tenure insecurity, refugee inflows, resettlement programs, and cross-border pastoralist mobility shape LULC change. Therefore, this study addresses these gaps by analyzing the association between socioeconomic dynamics, land-related policies, and LULC change from 1987 to 2025. A mixed-methods approach combined analysis of multi-temporal Landsat imagery with key informant interviews, focus group discussions, and policy reviews. Quantitative analysis showed that farmland area expanded from 100,998 ha (38.9%) in 1987–181,953 ha (70.1%) in 2025. Forest cover declined from 9680.7 ha (3.7%) to 7445.3 ha (2.8%), while wetlands and grasslands decreased from 41.4% to 21.1%, nearly halving their extent. Qualitative evidence also highlights the influxes of displaced communities, degradation of wetlands and protected areas, declining traditional livelihoods, and intensified land-use conflicts. Commercial land leases under Proclamation No. 280/2002 and 456/2005 were strongly associated with farmland expansion, while wetland loss was linked to cross-border pastoralist inflows. Settlement growth was driven by government-led resettlement and villagization programs, compounded by large-scale refugee influxes, which collectively increased flood risks, vegetation loss, and biodiversity decline. Weak policy enforcement, tenure insecurity, and poor management of refugee settlements, cross-border pastoral movements, and prioritization of investment for large-scale agricultural investments were identified as key drivers associated with LULC change. The study calls for institutional reforms to formalize customary land rights, regulate refugee settlements and pastoral mobility, strengthen participatory watershed management, and promote eco-tourism to achieve equity and resilience. Overall, the findings also underscore the urgent need for evidence-based policies that balance economic ambition with ecological resilience, tenure security, and social equity.
abstract_zh: 政策驱动的土地利用/土地覆盖（LULC）变化是全球面临的重大挑战，尤其在热带地区，农业扩张和投资政策正加速森林丧失和生态系统退化。在研究区域内，以往多数研究侧重于生物物理动态，而对土地政策、权属不安全、难民流入、重新安置计划及跨境牧民流动如何影响LULC变化的关注有限。因此，本研究通过分析1987年至2025年间社会经济动态、土地相关政策与LULC变化之间的关联，填补了上述空白。采用混合方法，结合多时相Landsat影像分析与关键知情人访谈、焦点小组讨论及政策审查。定量分析显示，农田面积从1987年的100,998公顷（38.9%）扩展至2025年的181,953公顷（70.1%）。森林覆盖率从9680.7公顷（3.7%）下降至7445.3公顷（2.8%），而湿地和草地面积从41.4%减少至21.1%，几乎减半。定性证据亦凸显了流离失所社区的涌入、湿地和保护区退化、传统生计衰退以及土地利用冲突加剧。第280/2002号和456/2005号公告下的商业土地租赁与农田扩张密切相关，而湿地丧失则与跨境牧民流入有关。定居点增长受政府主导的重新安置和村庄化计划驱动，加之大规模难民涌入，共同加剧了洪水风险、植被丧失和生物多样性下降。政策执行不力、权属不安全、难民定居点及跨境牧民流动管理不善，以及优先考虑大规模农业投资，被确定为与LULC变化相关的关键驱动因素。本研究呼吁进行制度性改革，以正式承认习惯土地权利、规范难民定居和牧民流动、加强参与式流域管理，并促进生态旅游，以实现公平与韧性。总体而言，研究结果亦强调了亟需基于证据的政策，以平衡经济雄心与生态韧性、权属安全和社会公平。
title: Socioeconomic and policy-triggered land use/land cover change in the Alwero Watershed, Gambela Region, Ethiopia
title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚甘贝拉地区阿尔韦罗流域社会经济与政策驱动的土地利用/土地覆盖变化

abstract: Consider a non-durable goods monopolist who maximizes the present discounted value of profits. In steady state, which elasticity (short run or long run) should the monopolist use in the classic inverse-elasticity rule? Under some assumptions, the appropriate elasticity is a convex combination of the short-run and long-run elasticities of demand, where the weights depend upon the monopolist’s discount factor and the dynamics inherent in demand.
abstract_zh: 考虑一个追求利润现值最大化的非耐用品垄断者。在稳态下，垄断者在经典的反弹性法则中应使用哪种弹性（短期还是长期）？在某些假设下，适当的弹性是需求短期与长期弹性的凸组合，其中权重取决于垄断者的贴现因子及需求固有的动态特性。
title: Which demand elasticity should a monopoly use?
title_zh: 垄断应使用哪种需求弹性？

abstract: We consider a single-step approach to estimating the parametric coefficients and bandwidth parameters in a partially linear model. We establish a direct connection between this estimator and the two-step estimator of Robinson (1988). Simulations show that the resulting estimator improves recovery of the nonparametric component and the fitted conditional mean in most designs, while delivering coefficient estimates that are typically comparable to Robinson’s two-step estimator.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑一种单步方法，用于估计部分线性模型中的参数系数和带宽参数。我们建立了该估计器与Robinson（1988）两步估计器之间的直接联系。模拟结果表明，在大多数设计下，由此产生的估计器改善了非参数成分的恢复及拟合条件均值，同时提供的系数估计通常与Robinson的两步估计器相当。
title: Single-step estimation of the partially linear model
title_zh: 部分线性模型的单步估计

abstract: Policymakers frequently implement environmental policies that are less ambitious than what voters would prefer. We document this gap using findings from previous research as well as evidence from climate policy in Austria's transport sector. To account for this pattern, we develop a model in which political parties compete with electoral platforms that involve multiple policy dimensions. When voters place greater weight on a primary issue -such as fiscal policy - than on environmental policy, we show that parties may refrain from proposing environmental reforms, even when these reforms enjoy broad public support. This dynamic arises once the primary issue becomes sufficiently salient to voters. We then examine potential ways to overcome this policy inertia, including the use of direct democratic instruments (e.g., referendums) and the delegation of environmental policy decisions from national to regional governments.
abstract_zh: 政策制定者经常实施的环境政策力度低于选民期望的水平。我们利用既有研究成果以及奥地利交通部门气候政策的实证证据，揭示了这一差距。为解释这一现象，我们构建了一个模型，其中政党在涉及多个政策维度的选举纲领中展开竞争。当选民对财政政策等首要议题的重视程度超过环境政策时，研究表明即使环境改革获得广泛公众支持，政党也可能放弃提出相关改革方案。这种动态机制在首要议题对选民具有足够显著重要性时便会显现。随后我们探讨了克服这种政策惯性的潜在路径，包括运用直接民主工具（如公投）以及将环境政策决策权从国家政府下放至地区政府。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 139
title: Voter preferences, party politics and environmental policy reform
title_zh: 选民偏好、政党政治与环境政策改革

abstract: Corporate climate mitigation targets are increasingly relevant, but ambition measurement remains inconsistent. Linear annual reduction (LAR) and compound annual reduction (CAR) are common measures of climate ambition, but they imply different reduction paths and may reverse ambition rankings when percentage reductions and target horizons differ. I derive the exact pairwise ranking-reversal condition, revealing that LAR favors shorter, shallower targets compared to CAR, and apply this framework to the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) Target Dashboard. The results confirm substantial ranking reversal depending on whether LAR or CAR is used to define ambition.
abstract_zh: 企业气候减缓目标日益重要，但雄心衡量标准仍不一致。线性年度减排（LAR）和复合年度减排（CAR）是衡量气候雄心的常用指标，但它们隐含不同的减排路径，且在百分比减排量和目标期限不同时，可能导致雄心排名发生逆转。我推导出精确的成对排名逆转条件，揭示LAR相较于CAR更偏好较短、较浅的目标，并将此框架应用于科学碳目标倡议（SBTi）目标仪表板。结果证实，根据使用LAR还是CAR来定义雄心，排名逆转现象显著存在。
title: Measuring climate ambition: Annualization and ranking discrepancy
title_zh: 衡量气候雄心：年度化与排名差异
